reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment — consistent with a no-action, evidence-only finding.

The cited text supports the preferred position: § 5 (p0023) sets economics as a pure revenue share on actual activity with no committed spend, and § 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms Customer may sell Inventory through other agents or third parties, so there is no volume restriction on us.

The only 'minimum' language (§ 13, p0062) is a vendor-side disclaimer that no minimum revenue or profit is guaranteed — not a purchase commitment by Customer — correctly characterized as out of scope for MINCOMMIT.
The rationale properly notes the § 4(a) no-termination-for-convenience point as context and defers it to the termination rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
